name: Crédule
overview: Cira Diallo, a naive young woman, leaves her conservative village for Dakar with dreams of fame. Supported by her mother, who projects her own ambitions onto her, Cira quickly discovers that celebrity is not just a matter of talent, but also of moral choices and influences. She faces constant dilemmas between staying true to her values, her burgeoning love for Al Amine, and the allure of show business.
